text:
alex: T-minus 45 until the EU cutover window (00:00 UTC). Posting final readiness checklist + rollback lanes. Pin currently set to v3.4.7 -> canary v3.5.0-beta. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/3.5.0 :eyes:

maria: quick status: canary image built + checksums match release artifact. docs link posted to #doc-updates.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary-id=cb-20260320-01, region=eu-west-1, traffic=5% -> 10m ramp plan applied. Logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/cb-20260320-01

jon: smoke tests running now. I'll watch error rates and traces. Pushed a tiny traffic test to the canary route.

sre-oncall: preflight checklist: infra health ✅, redis pool sizes checked ✅, disk pressure low ✅. Observability hook in place for automatic rollback on error-rate threshold.

jen: FYI prod-metrics team confirmed dashboards are good. Setting alert: canary-error-rate >2% for 5m OR p95 latency >200ms => alert + auto-rollback.

alex: Rollback command for fast path if needed: ```deploy-bot rollback --canary cb-20260320-01 --to v3.4.7 --force --reason "canary-failure"``` Keep that handy.

maria: small thing — model quantization flag differs between v3.4.7 and 3.5.0-beta. We ran sample prompts, mismatch rate ~0.8% (expected). Flagged in release notes under known-diffs.

tim: are we keeping allowed hotfixes during the freeze? ops agreed to allow only security/embeddings-cost hotfixes with explicit oncall approval. @sre-oncall you have the +1?

sre-oncall: yes, hotfix exception process active. Use /hotfix-exempt with link to PR and approval. Approvals are recorded in Deploybot.

jon: canary metrics after 12m: error-rate 0.1%, latency p95 140ms, memory stable. No anomalies in traces.

alex: great. we're green to slowly increase to 25% at +30m if metrics hold. Keep rollback lanes at the ready. Anyone want the final pin/unpin call?

maria: I can do the pin at +30m if we pass the next check.

jen: leaving the canary alerting in strict mode. If anything spikes we auto rollback and ping #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic bumped to 25% (cb-20260320-01). Canary health: OK.

jon: post-bump smoke still passing. will watch next 10m window.

alex: final note: release-notes + changelog posted, postmortem owner assigned as maria for any regressions, rollback owner is jon. Good luck team :rocket:
